dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NACL for Japan Medical Association, running on Linux with GnuCOBOL
evidence: no EXEC CICS/SQL, no COMP-3, consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/claim calculation) - specifically inpatient cost-sharing calculation (負担金算定サブ for hospitalization)
purpose.summary: ORCS02 is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that calculates patient cost-sharing amounts (負担金) for inpatient medical insurance claims. It handles complex Japanese health insurance rules including public assistance (公費), income-based limits, regional public expense programs, and various special calculation cases. The program is a large batch subprogram called by other ORCA modules.

notable_features: Large subprogram with 87 CALL statements and 279 PERFORM statements
33 COPY statements indicating heavy use of copybooks
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded, garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
OCCURS clauses for insurance combination tables
Fixed-format source with some lines over 72 chars
verdict.notes: File is 584KB / 11657 lines - a large production subprogram. Comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in garbled display. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. No COMP-3 is unusual for financial calculations but consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL usage patterns in ORCA. Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program likely contains the procedure division with the actual calculation logic.
